sentences.text: Inside your body... there's one organ secretly stealing your energy every single second.
It makes up only about two percent of your body weight, yet it burns around twenty percent of your body's energy.
Turned into electricity, your brain runs on about twenty watts.
Enough to power a small light bulb.
All day long, without ever switching off!
Because inside it, about eighty-six billion nerve cells keep firing signals, even while you sleep.
Studying hard or thinking deeply... won't make you lose weight.
Your brain uses only a tiny bit of extra energy when you concentrate.
Most of its energy goes into simply keeping itself alive.
And even crazier, in children around five years old, the brain can use more than half of the body's resting energy, because it's growing incredibly fast!
So, take care of your brain.
Eat well, drink water, and don't forget to sleep.
What other organ do you think is the most amazing in the human body?
